response.rationale: C1 is the most complete diagnosis: the pleural biopsy raw span proves a non-germinal center B-cell lymphoma, and the cavernous sinus enhancement plus systemic lymphadenopathy fit disseminated DLBCL. R7 explains the headache/diplopia/cavernous sinus findings but is an inflammatory diagnosis contradicted by the B-cell lymphoma biopsy and systemic disease. R4 is the same diagnosis without the subtype and is discounted as a correlated restatement.

rejected.why: Same diagnosis as C1 but lacks the non-germinal center subtype; redundant correlated restatement.
Prostate cancer history and pleural mass are explained by the B-cell lymphoma biopsy; no adenocarcinoma or prostate-specific evidence.
Temporal headache and photosensitivity are nonspecific; normal ESR/CRP and cavernous sinus enhancement plus B-cell lymphoma biopsy argue against GCA.
Sinus air-fluid levels are incidental; they do not explain cavernous sinus enhancement, systemic lymphadenopathy, or the B-cell lymphoma biopsy.
Lymphadenopathy and sinus findings are nonspecific; the pleural biopsy showing B-cell lymphoma, not granulomas, excludes sarcoidosis.
